evaluator.name: Grade Level Appropriateness Evaluator
evaluator.description: Evaluates which grade band a text is appropriate for at independent reading, plus an alternative band reachable with scaffolding, using word count, Flesch-Kincaid, the qualitative text complexity rubric, and background knowledge demands. Unlike the other literacy evaluators this one takes no grade input, so supported_grades records the grades spanned by the bands it can return rather than constraining an input.

steps.description: Single-call LLM step that produces the EvaluatorOutput JSON. TODO: the Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level is still computed by the model from the formula embedded in system.txt. Every other evaluator precomputes FK deterministically as a `preprocessing` step (textstat / text-readability, rounded to 2dp) and injects it as {fk_score}. Migrate GLA to the same preprocessing contract so the quantitative signal stops varying run to run.
